envelope.description: Add changeLogBodyLines binding + wire Changes/Feedback into renderPlanBuildRecordMd

body.title: Add changeLogBodyLines binding + wire Changes/Feedback into renderPlanBuildRecordMd
body.summary: Add changeLogBodyLines(changeLog: ChangeLog | undefined): string[] to format/bindings.ts (sc3-declared sibling; omit-slot: [] when absent/empty), mirroring feedbackBodyLines. In renderPlanBuildRecordMd, after the Tasks-validated section, push a `## Changes` block from changeLogBodyLines(rec.body.changeLog) and a `## Feedback` block from feedbackBodyLines(rec.body.feedback) — omit-slot, byte-identical when both absent. Co-locate binding + renderer tests.
acceptanceChecks: renderPlanBuildRecordMd shows Changes/Feedback when present; byte-identical to pre-change when both absent (ac3/ac4/k5)

tests.name: renderPlanBuildRecordMd: with changeLog → '## Changes'; with feedback → '## Feedback'; with neither → byte-identical to the pre-change render
